subject.title: chore(deps): bump the production-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 22 updates

question: Should maintainers accept this 22-package production dependency group as a single update after the green checks, or ask for a narrower split before merge?
rationale: The patch has no concrete code defect, but grouped production dependency compatibility and rollback granularity are maintainer-owned release-risk choices.

options.title: Accept grouped update
options.body: Approve the manifest-only Dependabot group with the current green CI, CodeQL, secret scan, Playwright, and Vercel preview evidence while owning the grouped compatibility risk.

options.title: Split higher-risk packages
options.body: Ask Dependabot or a maintainer to separate Convex, TanStack Start/Router, sharp, resend, or CLI/schema packages if isolated production rollback is more important than update batching.

recommendation.title: Accept grouped update
recommendation.body: Approve the manifest-only Dependabot group with the current green CI, CodeQL, secret scan, Playwright, and Vercel preview evidence while owning the grouped compatibility risk.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest current routing signal from dependency-block blame and CODEOWNERS on core backend surfaces affected by this production bump.
